ios.desc:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

quotes.text:
I built an iOS app called Parachute Backup to solve a problem I kept running into: iCloud is great for syncing, but it’s not a real backup. If a file is deleted or changed, that change propagates everywhere. I wanted a way to keep an offline, unalterable copy of my iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive files—on storage I control.

What it does:
 • Backs up iCloud Photos (including originals, edits, Live Photos, and Shared Albums) and iCloud Drive with full fidelity
 • Supports USB drives, network/NAS, Google Drive, and other destinations
 • Runs automatically on a schedule, or manually when you choose
 • Integrates with Live Activities and Dynamic Island for real-time progress
 • No subscriptions, no lock-in—just a one-time purchase

The idea is to make a set-and-forget backup layer that works alongside iCloud so you always have your own private copy.

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/parachute-backup-mobile/id6749824842]
More info: [https://parachuteapps.com/parachute-mobile]

Would love feedback—especially from people who deal with photo archiving, NAS storage, or long-term data preservation.
